title: OpenAPI Docs with Swagger UI and Redoc: A Practical Guide
title_es: OpenAPI con Swagger UI y Redoc: guía práctica
description: Complete runnable examples for documenting REST APIs with OpenAPI. Includes Python/FastAPI, JavaScript/Express, Java/SpringDoc, a sample OpenAPI YAML spec, and CI linting with Redocly.
description_es: Ejemplos completos y ejecutables para documentar APIs REST con OpenAPI. Incluye Python/FastAPI, JavaScript/Express, Java/SpringDoc, un spec OpenAPI YAML de ejemplo, y linting en CI con Redocly.
